# Northwind Access Ltd - company profile

Northwind Access Ltd designs, supplies, installs and maintains facade access equipment for high-rise buildings in the UK and the Gulf.
Our range covers building maintenance units (BMUs), temporary suspended cradles, davit systems and monorail systems for window cleaning.
We also hire MEWPs and cherry pickers with trained operators.
All equipment is designed to BS EN 1808 and certified under LOLER 1998.
